libras.texto: VLibras, by the Brazilian Federal Government, translates the site's text into Brazilian Sign Language with a 3D avatar. When turned on, pages load VLibras from gov.br servers.

animacoes.texto: The logo intro, the water that reacts to the mouse, the bubbles and the transitions between pages.
animacoes.estado_sistema_reduz: Your device is asking for less motion, so animations are off. On Windows this comes from Settings > Accessibility > Visual effects > Animation effects (off); on a Mac, from Accessibility > Display > Reduce motion. To see the animations, turn the effects on in your device or choose "Always on" here.
animacoes.estado_sistema_ok: Animations are on, following your device.
animacoes.estado_forcado_ligado: Animations are always on in this browser, even if your device asks for less motion.
animacoes.estado_forcado_desligado: Animations are off in this browser.
animacoes.webgl: This browser has no graphics acceleration (WebGL2), so the intro water doesn't show. In Chrome or Edge: Settings > System > "Use graphics acceleration when available", then restart the browser.
